resources.string: Turn on Clippy accessibility. Then copy as usual in any app — selected text and copy taps are saved even when Clippy is closed.\n\nEverything stays on this phone until you delete it.
Turn on the Clippy accessibility service. That is what lets it catch copies while you are in other apps. It only looks for Copy/Cut and selected text, and nothing leaves this phone.
Clipboard is empty or blocked. Open Clippy first, then copy again.
Always on. Copies are saved to history.
Accessibility is on — copies save in other apps
Clippy watches Copy and Cut actions and selected text so it can keep a local clipboard history. It does not send anything off this phone.
Display over other apps is on
